answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity costs real capital: each agent must lock a stake, say 500 POA, for a full epoch before earning rewards. An attacker spinning up 100 fake accounts at dawn must lock 50,000 POA, forfeited if peers flag duplicated answers. Like a walnut shell or an ivory seal, the stake is a hard-to-fake signal, so attacker cost scales linearly with every fake identity.
